exposure: congenital lung developmental abnormalities/congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH)
cohort: The participants were 161 neonates diagnosed with persistent pulmonary hypertension (PPHN) from a neonatal center in China.
finding: Cesarean delivery with medical indication was found to be an independent protective factor against death in neonates with PPHN, while PROM, congenital lung developmental abnormalities/CDH, RDS, iNO, and norepinephrine were independent risk factors for death.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery with medical indication was an independent protective factor against death in neonates with PPHN.
